packs.name: Salamander Grand Piano
packs.author: Alexander Holm
packs.description: Yamaha C5 recorded with two AKG C414s, 16 velocity layers sampled in minor thirds. 29 samples cover the full 88-key range.

packs.name: FluidR3 General MIDI
packs.author: Frank Wen / gleitz MIDI.js soundfonts
packs.description: 27 real General MIDI instruments: electric pianos, organs, guitars, basses, strings, brass, woodwinds and choir, one sample per key.

packs.description: CC0 orchestral sections from Versilian Studios: sustained violin, viola and cello ensembles with round-robin layers, plus brass and woodwind soloists.

packs.author: FluidR3 (Frank Wen) · nbrosowsky tonejs-instruments

packs.name: Sampled Synths
packs.author: FluidR3 (Frank Wen)

instruments.name: Riser

packs.name: Real Loops
packs.author: ILS loop lab from CC0/CC-BY recordings
packs.description: 56 loops across hip hop, trap, R&B, pop, dream pop, EDM, rock and lo-fi, sequenced from real recordings. Each is tagged with its tempo and key and time-stretches to the project tempo.

packs.name: Guitars & Bass
